verses.note: Even at a moment of famine and fear, the promise to one family reaches past it to "all nations of the earth". God's dealings with Isaac are never only about Isaac's household; they are the channel of blessing for the world.

The promise to a single fugitive includes every family on earth. God's purpose for Jacob is never only about Jacob's safety, and Paul reads this promise as the gospel announced in advance to the Gentiles (Galatians 3:8).
